subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should OpenClaw add Google Chat non-mention space ingestion, and if so should the approved design use user OAuth, app/admin-approved message scopes, Workspace Events/space events, or a narrower unsupported-for-now stance?
rationale: The remaining request expands message visibility and credential handling beyond the current service-account webhook model, so the implementation shape is a security and product boundary rather than a narrow adapter fix.

options.title: Approve a scoped ingestion design
options.body: Define the accepted Google auth model, consent/admin requirements, config shape, redaction/SecretRef handling, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Split thread work from all-message auth
options.body: Keep or land thread-routing/session fixes separately, and leave all-message ingestion tracked behind the security design decision.

options.title: Decline all-message ingestion for now
options.body: Document that Google Chat spaces remain mention-gated until OpenClaw has an approved broader-message-access model.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped ingestion design
recommendation.body: Define the accepted Google auth model, consent/admin requirements, config shape, redaction/SecretRef handling, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Google Chat thread-routing history and is the best visible owner for a cross-cutting product/security decision in this area.
